style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard light, high exposure
motion_rule: every beat the ant scuttles sideways beneath his swaying tower, never lying still, never pushed; hit, loaded or bitten, he skids and scrabbles on; camera keeps pace at his eye level, nonstop; shot size: he and his tower fill the frame top to bottom, faces up to full frame; the ant never leaves frame
character: the ant: glossy black ant, tired eyes, twitchy antennae; the fat bronze dung beetle boss; worker ants; ONE mosquito
props: ONE tower on the ant's back: gold coin stack, armchair on it, iron on the chair, potted ficus wobbling on top; ONE banknote ball; ONE bread loaf; ONE crumb; furry mic bottom right
environment: sunlit sandy yard; a steep grassy anthill slope fills the background to the frame top; worker ants dash both ways behind and before him with a suitcase, a blank telly, a wallpaper roll, a dumbbell, a cardboard box

audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, weary but brisk, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ya ta-SHU na se-BYE BOL'-she, chem VYE-shu SAM. a v i-TO-ge hva-TA-yet TOL'-ko na od-NU KROSH-ku
audio.pacing: 0.6-6.2 one unbroken flow; after 6.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: coin clinks, sand scrapes, swooshes, buzz, crunch

timeline.a: he already scuttles sideways under his tower, ficus teetering, as worker ants with a suitcase and a box dash both ways; he dips, skids and scuttles on
he carries the tower left to right, legs scrabbling, ficus swaying, jaws flapping, as a telly ant cuts in front
he zigzags back right to left, legs buckling, nose ploughing the sand, jaws flapping, ducking a wallpaper roll swung over his tower
he scuttles with the tower, jaws flapping, as the beetle boss rolls alongside and yanks the coins out from under; armchair, iron and ficus thump back onto him; he buckles
he scuttles after the ball and his coins, still under the tower, jaws flapping, as a dumbbell ant cuts across
he scuttles toward the loaf as the boss's huge snout sweeps past the lens beside him, snapping ONE crumb off it and flicking it into his face; he skids, heaving it onto his armchair
he scrambles sideways under the tower and crumb, legs buckling, iron sliding, as a suitcase ant and a box ant whip by at the lens

he scuttles with the crumb as ONE angry mosquito darts across the lens, proboscis bared, wings bristling, huge beside him, and bites the crumb; he scrabbles sideways, yanking it back, ficus whipping, as a telly ant swerves round them
he skids sideways as the crumb snaps in half, tower lurching, sand bursting at the lens; the mosquito zips off with its half
he scuttles on mid-slide, gulping his half whole on the run, his bulging cheeks sweeping past the lens filling the frame
he scuttles right to left as ONE gold coin flicked by the boss clinks onto the ficus; the tower teeters, he buckles, skids and scrabbles on

must_appear: tower on his back 0.0; beetle yanks coins out 3.2; crumb in his face 6.2; mosquito bites crumb 7.4; coin onto ficus 9.3; huge faces: beetle 6.2, mosquito 7.4, ant 8.6
negative_prompt: held mic, a second mosquito, slow motion, any word after 6.2, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, pause inside a line, extra word, mouth shut, duplicate props, floating objects, a hero running at the camera, a wide shot, a distant hero, a parked camera, static scenery, a motionless first or last second, top-down view, a cart, sky, sun in frame, low angle, standing on hind legs, on the spot, a hero lying still, a hero being dragged
